description: Find the closest colors to a hex or RGB color in one or more palettes, ranked by CIEDE2000 color difference (deltaE: under 1 looks identical, under 3 is a close match, over 10 is a different color). Use it to turn a picked color into a bead, thread or yarn to buy.

palettes.description: Palette ids or names (e.g. "dmc", "delica", "perler", "mard"). Ids: perler-midi, hama-midi, artkal-s, nabbi, mard-185, mard-221, mard-291, miyuki-delica, dmc-floss, dmc-diamond, lego, minecraft-blocks, minecraft-map, red-heart-super-saver, pixel-art-256. Default: perler-midi, hama-midi, artkal-s, mard-291, miyuki-delica, dmc-floss.

name: find_closest
title: Closest color codes to a color
